annotations.title: Run an AgentMart tool that changes something without destroying anything and without spending

description: Run one AgentMart tool that is not in your list and changes something or reaches outside; it never runs one that destroys or spends. Give tool, its ack from agentmart_tools, and arguments. Call a tool in your list, such as buy, directly. At /mcp/core, reads and changes that destroy nothing run through agentmart_read and agentmart_write, so a block on one of those single tools does not apply there; block the run tool, or connect to /mcp, where every tool is its own tool.

ack.description: The ack agentmart_tools gives for this tool. Without the right one nothing runs, and the answer gives the tool's description, input_schema and ack.

arguments.description: The tool's own arguments, as its input_schema says.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

tool.description: The tool to run (agentmart_tools finds it).
